object: steel workshop tool cart: sheet body with drawers, on castors
understanding: Sheet-steel box stiffened by its drawer fronts; side and back panels dent, the top tray edge bends, the castors and handle stay as they are.
Hurt by rolling into things, tools dropped on the top, being tipped over. Rarely crushed.
Enamel chips on drawer edges and corners; rust in the chips, at the base, and under the top tray; oil grime everywhere a hand goes.
